## Every teleport your server needs.

Players expect homes, TPA, warps, spawn and `/rtp`. Usually that means a big all-in-one plugin, or four small ones that each look and work differently. **xTeleport does every teleport in one small plugin for Paper and Folia, with one config, one look, and any command you don't use switched off.**

**[Read the docs](https://plugins.xenastudios.co/xteleport/)** · **[Switching from EssentialsX](https://plugins.xenastudios.co/xteleport/switching/)** · **[Report a bug](https://github.com/xena-studios/plugins/issues/new/choose)**

---

## Why server owners pick it

- **Every feature free.** No premium version, no early-access builds, nothing behind a Patreon.
- **One plugin, not four.** Homes, TPA, warps, spawn and RTP, with one config, one look and one set of messages.
- **Switch off what you don't use.** Every command can be turned off, renamed with aliases or given its own permission. A command you turn off isn't registered, so another plugin can have it.
- **Nobody dies arriving.** A home or warp that's now in lava, inside blocks or over the void is refused with a message, checked after its chunk loads in the background.
- **RTP that doesn't lag.** One candidate chunk at a time, checked on its own thread, with a cap on searches at once (3 by default) so a crowd typing `/rtp` can't touch your TPS. Pre-generated with Chunky? Tell it to stick to chunks that already exist.
- **You won't feel it running.** Nothing repeats: a warmup is a short check on the waiting player's own thread that ends with it, and requests run out when they're next read, never on a timer. The damage listener exists only while someone is warming up. Homes are read in the background as players join, and saved in the background as they change.
- **Every change applies on reload**, even turning commands on or off. Only a change of storage waits for a restart.
- **Paper and Folia.** One jar runs on Paper, Purpur and Folia. Every teleport is asynchronous and nothing assumes a main thread.
- **Easy to switch to.** The same command names as EssentialsX, so players keep typing what they know, and its homes, warps and spawn imported with a dry run first.

---

## What players get

- **`/sethome`, `/home`, `/homes`:** a clickable list, and `/home bed` for their bed or anchor.
- **`/tpa` and `/tpahere`** with Accept and Deny to click. Several requests can wait at once, and `/tptoggle` turns them off.
- **`/warp`, `/warps` and `/spawn`.**
- **`/rtp`** to a safe random spot: no lava, water, leaves or oceans, under the roof in the Nether and off the main island in the End.
- **Warmups** that count down on the action bar and cancel if they move or get hurt.

---

## What your staff get

- **Limits by permission or group:** `xteleport.homes.<n>`, or a LuckPerms group such as `vip` under `homes.limits` in the config.
- **Cooldowns and Vault costs** per command, taken after the warmup and refunded if a teleport fails, with bypass permissions.
- **Anyone's homes, online or not:** `/home Steve:base`, `/homes Steve`.
- **Per-warp permissions**, spawn on first join, every join or respawn, and per-world RTP radii and permissions.
- **`/xteleport rtpcheck`** to try a world's RTP settings without teleporting anyone.
- **Works with `/back`:** every teleport uses the command cause, so xUtilities' `/back` returns from it.
- **PlaceholderAPI:** `%xteleport_homes%`, `%xteleport_homes_limit%`, `%xteleport_requests%`, `%xteleport_cooldown_rtp%` and more.
- **A developer API**, so your other plugins' teleports get the same warmup, cooldown, cost and safety check.

---

## Up and running in a minute

1. Drop the jar in `plugins/` and start the server. Homes are kept in SQLite with nothing to set up, or MySQL/MariaDB.
2. Stand where you want them and run `/setspawn` and `/setwarp shop`.
3. Set warmups, cooldowns, home limits and RTP's worlds in `plugins/xTeleport/config.yml`, then `/xteleport reload`.

**Coming from EssentialsX?** Install xTeleport next to it and run `/xteleport import essentials` to see what it finds, then `/xteleport import essentials confirm`. Everyone's homes, the warps and the spawn come across. Then remove EssentialsX, or turn off its teleport commands.

Full setup, every setting and every permission: **[plugins.xenastudios.co/xteleport](https://plugins.xenastudios.co/xteleport/)**

**Requires** Paper 1.21.11 or newer (or Purpur or Folia) and Java 21 or newer. SQLite out of the box, or MySQL/MariaDB. Vault and PlaceholderAPI are optional.
